card.name: Inside all-caps label sentences
card.fires_on: Words in ALL-CAPS text, mainly drug-label warnings, where the next word is likely also in capitals. Also the close of a download-size note like "(11.7 MB)" before an all-caps chapter opening.

modes.label: All-caps warning text
modes.description: Plural noun endings or verbs like HAVE inside capitalised boxed warnings.
modes.example: IN SPITE OF THE USE OF AN INFUSION PUMP, OVERDO<<SES>> HAVE OCCURRED.

modes.label: Download size before caps opening
modes.description: The closing parenthesis after a file size in a book chapter list, followed by an all-caps first words of the chapter.
